series_name: TB3MS - 3-Month Treasury Bill Secondary Market Rate, Discount Basis
transformations: bank-discount quote -> 91-day bill price -> geometric monthly holding return; lagged one month so no month uses its own rate
caveats: A rolling-bill approximation, not a traded fund.  Validated against the Fama/French 1-month T-bill return series.

transformations: percent -> decimal; already a realised monthly holding return

series_name: LBMA Gold Price PM, USD/troy oz
transformations: daily PM auction price -> last obs. of each month -> pct change
caveats: Gold pays no income, so price return IS total return before storage cost.  Observations before 1971-09 fall under the fixed/managed dollar-gold regime and are excluded from the primary analysis.

series_name: Mkt-RF + RF - value-weighted return of all CRSP U.S. common stocks
transformations: percent -> decimal; excess market return plus the risk-free rate
caveats: Broad U.S. equity, not the S&P 500 itself.  Gross of fees and trading costs.  Correlation with the S&P 500 total return is ~0.99.

series_name: Equal-weighted blend of the value-weighted Hardw (computer hardware), Softw (software) and Chips (electronic equipment) industry portfolios
transformations: percent -> decimal; simple average of the three industry returns each month; starts 1965-07, the first month all three industries exist
caveats: Chosen over broad large-growth portfolios because those understate Nasdaq-100 volatility by ~33% and its dot-com drawdown by ~30pp.  This composite matches QQQ closely (corr 0.97, vol ratio 1.06, 2000-02 drawdown -81.0% vs QQQ's -81.1%) but is pure technology and omits the non-tech third of the Nasdaq-100.

series_name: Hi 30 - highest dividend-yield 30% of U.S. stocks, value weighted
caveats: Dividend-yield sort only.  SCHD additionally screens for cash-flow / debt / ROE quality and dividend persistence, which this proxy lacks.

series_name: BIG HiPRIOR - large caps in the top prior-(12,2)-return tercile, value weighted, rebalanced monthly
caveats: Academic long-only large-cap momentum.  Monthly reconstitution makes it more aggressive and higher-turnover than SPMO, which rebalances semi-annually inside the S&P 500.  Gross of all costs.

series_name: CPIAUCNS - Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers, NSA
transformations: monthly index level, not seasonally adjusted; log-interpolated for 2025-10
caveats: Contributions are scaled by CPI(t-1) so no month uses a figure that was not yet published; terminal wealth is deflated by CPI(t).  BLS never published 2025-10; the level is geometrically interpolated from the neighbouring months.
